rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and dated predictions before data; synthetic at real counts showing the first-order correction fails and amending before real data (A1); replication on 71 units / 35 periods in two item families with two variants; 3 natives with dated predictions; confirm.py frozen, guarded, dry-run. Missing: holdout, latent-factor rival, message-level resampling.
rationale.faithfulness: The field-removed pairwise model captures a median 0.91 of beyond-field multi-information and recovers known teams and rooms as signed pair blocks (p 0.0005), but it leaves a significant field-sized remainder in 83% of units and cannot be separated from a heterogeneous-field rival or a planted group term. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G2 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: A diagnostic: co-usage compresses to pairs plus shared topics, and raw I2/IN is not evidence of pairwise sufficiency at swarm rates. No lever.

one_line: Convention co-usage is pairs plus fields (field-removed pairwise sufficiency 0.91; remainder 3-5% of I_N, field-sized); no separable group term; raw I2/IN 0.95 is uninformative at village rates.

models.note: Pairs plus fields capture ~91%; field-sized remainder left

v2.claim: Convention co-usage is explained by pairwise couplings plus shared fields (field-removed ρ_F median 0.91; higher-order remainder 3–5% of I_N, below a heterogeneous-field reference in 92% of units); no unit meets the egregore rule, but the instrument cannot separate a group term from a heterogeneous field

ladder.factor: native structure detected (#12 team couplings p 0.0005; room blocks)
penalty: group term and heterogeneous shared field not separable; egregore threshold unreachable even when planted

v2.decision: model convention co-usage with pairwise couplings and shared fields; don't look for group terms with this instrument
v2.rater: coordinator, updated after round 1b (H101 report); independent rater pending
